Thanks for the ping — reviewed the partial answers and note below a pragmatic path we can present to CustHealth.

Short recommendation (to share with CustHealth by 10/01):
1) SOC 2 scope: keep the initial SOC scope limited to core inference runtime services and customer-managed data ingress components. For the HIPAA pilot, add the ingestion service + S3 buckets used for the pilot to scope. This limits audit delta while covering PHI flows.
2) BAA: yes — a BAA should be executed before we accept PHI in production. We can provide a Redwood BAA template; legal turnaround 3–5 business days once countersigned.
3) Data residency: we support EU-only residency via isolated VPC + region pinning; need a short ops runbook for export controls if they plan cross-region replication.
4) Encryption / KMS: we offer customer-managed KMS with HSM-backed keys for enterprise Dedicated and Private deployments; hosted customers get managed KMS with AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit.

Owners & rough ETA:
- Priyom: draft BAA + confirm legal timeline (ETA 10/02).
- Marissa: draft SOC scope change and estimate additional audit effort/cost (ETA 10/01).
- Ben: coordinate with CustHealth to collect the completed questionnaire and schedule the 30-min follow-up.

Marissa Cole
